info.name: VectorSpace API v1
info.description:
A second client of the same /api/v1 the web app uses, unchanged. Generated by apps/api/postman/build_collection.py; edit that, not this file.

Run order matters: Me saves the ids later folders use. Data is the synthetic Demo School from app/seed.py locally and in CI, or the synthetic pilot school when deployed.

Requests marked by allow_writes leave rows behind and are skipped unless the environment sets allow_writes=true.

exec: // Every request: answered within the time budget, and any body is JSON.
